Looking at this auction decision:

**Current State:**
- Auction for ELECTRIC_COMPANY at $51 (OpenAI leading)
- I have: 2/4 railroads, Oriental Avenue, $1,242 cash
- My established strategy: railroads scale better (4-railroad = $200 rent vs. single utility = $4-24 rent)

**Analysis:**
I explicitly passed on this utility in my opening turn message. Single utilities are marginal value plays—only worthwhile when both are held (rare). My capital is better allocated to completing railroad monopoly or building monopolies on color sets.

At $51 with Gemini still bidding, this will likely hit $60+. That's money better held for Reading Railroad or Park Place opportunities.

Consistent with my strategy: **drop out**.
